annotations.title: Budget of a Polish municipality: spending, debt, EU funds

description: Use for the budget of one municipality: what it spends money on, its debt and its EU funds. Pieniądze Twojej gminy (finwire_gmina_spending_per_capita): for one Polish municipality (gmina) or city with county rights - executed spending per resident by category (schools, social help, family benefits and nurseries, roads, waste and water, administration, culture, sport, municipal housing, fire brigades, interest on debt) vs neighbouring municipalities, municipalities of similar type and size and Poland (Ministry of Finance Rb-28S, last full year and current year to date), investment share, debt per resident at the end of the latest quarter (Rb-Z), EU funding per resident 2021-2027 and 2014-2020 with the largest projects (only projects located in one municipality; natural persons are not named). Without a municipality: national figures; with metric: ranking.

family.description: Ranking of municipalities (default) or of cities with county rights.

metric.description: Ranking instead of one municipality: total, invest, debt, eu or a category (oswiata, pomoc, rodzina, drogi, komunalne, administracja, kultura, sport, mieszkania, bezpieczenstwo, dlug, pozostale).

municipality.description: Municipality name (e.g. "Kraków", "Bielsk Podlaski") or 7-digit TERYT code. Omit for national figures or a ranking.
